title: Artificial intelligence questioned the authorship of the world's most expensive painting
hook_text: Is the world's priciest painting fake?
script:
The world's most expensive painting just faced an AI audit.
Researcher Atila Soares da Costa Filho used an AI system to analyze Salvator Mundi.
The model specifically examined the brushwork and facial features in the portrait.
It calculated an eighty-one percent probability that a pupil painted it.
This challenges the claim that Leonardo da Vinci was the sole creator.
The painting sold for four hundred fifty million dollars in twenty seventeen.
Now, AI findings suggest the master might have had significant help.
Could a machine rewrite the history of art?
